description: LEGACY: for accounts that still have a Polygon owner wallet record. A new account funds Polymarket with fund_polymarket_from_arc and Hyperliquid with fund_hypercore_from_arc instead (this tool answers arc_home_venue_wallet_unavailable for them). Stages Polymarket funding from the Arc home Safe: an owner-signed Circle Gateway withdrawal whose destination Felix resolves to this account's own Polygon owner wallet (the client refuses any other destination before signing). Completion is native USDC in the Polygon owner wallet, NOT Polymarket collateral: the result sets venue_funded=false and returns next_action fund_market(venue=prediction_market), a separate owner-signed call. Hyperliquid and Derive are refused before anything is prepared. Not live-certified on this release.

amount_usd.description: USDC to deliver to the Polygon owner wallet, at most six decimals.

idempotency_key.description: Required durable workflow key. Reuse it after any timeout or restart.

max_fee_usd.description: Owner-paid Circle Gateway fee ceiling. Defaults to 0.05.

resume_reconciliation.description: Set true only to resume this exact interrupted funding operation.

submit_destination_mint.description: Also broadcast the final Polygon mint into the owner wallet with the owner key through your own FELIX_POLYGON_RPC_URL. Defaults to true; that gas is owner paid.

venue.description: Destination venue. Only polymarket is supported by this tool; for Hyperliquid use fund_hypercore_from_arc.

name: arc_home_fund_venue
